# GroupDocs.Watermark documentation

> On-premise SDK docs for adding, searching, editing, and removing text and image watermarks in PDF, Microsoft Office, Visio, OpenDocument, email, and image files.
> Platforms: net | java | python-net | nodejs-java | mcp
> .NET TFMs: net45, net6.0, net8.0, net10.0

## Hubs

- https://docs.groupdocs.com/watermark/net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/watermark/java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/watermark/python-net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/watermark/nodejs-java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/watermark/mcp/
